extracted.intended_audience: aspiring humorists, comedians, and writers who want to submit jokes, articles, cartoons, photos, or videos to Laugh Factory Magazine / Laugh Factory website
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines/call for submissions to Laugh Factory Magazine and the Laugh Factory website, inviting comedians and writers to submit jokes, articles, cartoons, photos, or videos for editorial consideration, membership, homepage features, and possible payment. Targets contributors seeking publication/exposure with Laugh Factory.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accepted submission types
rubrics_metrics.description: “Submit your funniest articles, stories or cartoons ...” and elsewhere “Submit your best content, jokes, photos, or videos ...”.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page explicitly invites multiple formats: articles, stories, cartoons, jokes, photos, and videos as acceptable submission types for consideration. No further technical specs (length, file types) are provided on-page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose of submission / editorial consideration
rubrics_metrics.description: “Submit your funniest articles, stories or cartoons to be considered for our magazine staff.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions are for editorial consideration by the Laugh Factory magazine staff (i.e., to be selected for magazine publication or staff-picked features).

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection authority / review
rubrics_metrics.description: “Let's see what our Doctors of the Soul have to say.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implied criterion: submissions will be reviewed/curated by Laugh Factory staff or designated reviewers (referred to jovially as 'Doctors of the Soul'). No explicit scoring rubric or review criteria are provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exposure and compensation promise
rubrics_metrics.description: “Get featured on our homepage and turn your wisecracks into cold hard cash.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Successful submissions may be featured on the Laugh Factory homepage and may receive payment. The page does not specify payment amounts, terms, or frequency—only that there is potential monetary compensation and homepage exposure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Membership/share benefits
rubrics_metrics.description: “Submit your best content, jokes, photos, or videos to become an exclusive Laugh Factory member and have your content shared on our website.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submitting can lead to becoming an 'exclusive Laugh Factory member' and having content shared on the site. No criteria for membership eligibility or member benefits are detailed beyond 'content shared'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial taste / longevity preference (Hall of Fame language)
rubrics_metrics.description: “Laugh Factory Magazine Hall of Fame — Comedy that ages like fine wine. Browse articles from world-famous comedians. Our featured articles are hand-picked from organic laugh farms where free range jokes are written with tender loving care.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implied editorial preference for material with enduring comedic value (content that 'ages like fine wine') and curated, hand-picked pieces. This suggests editors favor timeless, well-crafted comedic writing, though no explicit quality checklist is given.

rubrics_metrics.name: Call-to-action framing / playful gatekeeping
rubrics_metrics.description: “So you thinK you’re funny? Let's see what our Doctors of the Soul have to say.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site frames submission as a challenge/contest-like invitation, implying that comedic quality and originality will be judged. This is more of a rhetorical prompt than a technical requirement, but it signals that originality and perceived funniness are central evaluation factors.
